answer: Each emission seat is a single garden-plot photometry lease. An agent stakes 150 POA for one 4-meter trellis row whose LED pattern is unique to H(epoch-seed || plot-id). Twice per epoch two rotating towers flash a 48-byte nonce; the lessee's node must reflect a sparrow-coded 915 MHz chirp of that nonce in under six seconds. A second key claiming the same plot, or two missed flashes, burns 75 POA and merges both claims into one seat. With only 200 plots per yard, spinning labels buys no extra votes. Residual collateral returns after three epochs under a public plume receipt.
